description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit pledge records with the collections they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each pledge with its id, reference, donor, the amount pledged, the currency, the moment made, the moment the pledge or its next installment falls due, the years it spans, the balance the pledge record states, its status (open, paid or written off), any board or staff note recorded with a write-off and the amount the first year’s revenue record counts for it; each payment with its id, the pledge it collects on, the moment collected and the amount; each follow-up with its id, the pledge, the moment recorded and a note. The signed report gives the pledges and the collections, each open pledge past its due moment with a balance left against a follow-up recorded on or after that moment, each stated balance against the amount pledged less the payments recorded, each written-off pledge against a board or staff note, and each pledge spanning more than one year against the revenue counted in its first year, and counts them, and names divergent pledge records: a pledge past due with no follow-up recorded, a pledge balance that does not recompute from the payments recorded, a pledge written off with no board or staff note, and a multi-year pledge counted in full in the first year’s revenue record; then a payment naming a pledge the records do not hold and payments above the amount pledged, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No pledges, no reading moment beside open pledges, or an open pledge with no due moment leaves those points unverified. Pledges, payments and follow-ups match by letters and digits, the payments for one pledge add together, amounts compare to the cent and moments to the minute where both carry a time. This reads whether each donor promise is followed, collected, balanced and counted as the pledge records set it. Verdict nonprofit_pledge_divergent, nonprofit_pledge_partial, nonprofit_pledge_unverified or nonprofit_pledge_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-pledge-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
